examples.en: Investors were spooked by slowing economies.
examples.zh: 投资者们因经济增长缓慢而变得紧张。

examples.en: His theory was inapplicable to many underdeveloped economies.
examples.zh: 他的理论不适用于许多不发达的经济体。

examples.en: Some companies are simply trying to get bigger to achieve economies of scale.
examples.zh: 一些公司只是试图靠扩张获得规模经济。
